pages.observation: Reading order: (1) top-left caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.'; (2) top-right teal label 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' (the doctor is typing at a laptop with a setup screen showing); (3) middle-left balloon 'We can organise our clinic workflow here.', tail to the doctor; (4) middle-right balloon 'And our team can use tools suited to each staff role.', tail to the receptionist, who holds up a phone with a calendar icon; (5) label 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff' at the lower left of that panel; (6) bottom panel 'One team. Better coordination.', tail to the doctor, with the receptionist standing beside her holding a phone. Speakers read correctly. Issues: (a) The label 'WELBUK PRACTICE for the clinic' sits in the top-right corner over the window and wall, not on or next to the laptop screen it describes, so it floats loose. (b) The label 'WELBUK CARE for clinic staff' sits at the bottom left over the desk and laptop in the background, not on the receptionist's phone. A reader may tie it to the background laptop instead of the phone. (c) Page 01 is in bright daytime; this page is lit by sunset through the window with no caption explaining the time change (same day after hours, or another day?). The caption only says 'begins its onboarding'. (d) In panel 3 the receptionist suddenly appears in the doctor's office; it is not shown how she got there or that this is the same moment. (e) Small: the doctor's hairstyle looks looser in the bottom panel than the bun in panel 1. No lettering covers a face or an important hand or prop.
